name: Nyírgelse (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red, blue and yellow triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nyírgelse (a quartered blue and red shield with a patriarchal cross, a ship, a ploughshare and bars, bordered in yellow) above the name NYÍRGELSE in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of red, blue and yellow triangles
